title: doellingeria scabra
intro: Doellingeria scabra, commonly known as Rough Stem Woodland Sunflower, is a flowering plant species in the aster family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exerting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Doellingeria scabra are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibiting anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpenoids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
